findings: Stable worker add_adapter calls activate_adapter; model manager attaches itself to model.lora_manager. BaseLinear slot layout is [slots,1,rank,input] and [slots,1,output,rank], copies CPU A/B directly with alpha/rank=1.
38085 closed; comments identify 0.18.1 fix. 48934 closed by merged PR48850 at 2026-08-19T04:55:21Z. 42583 open TP4 startup issue does not establish TP1 failure.

42125 same-name prefix cache stale reuse remains open; 48352 open content-key proposal. Official available workarounds include disabling cache or unique names. This experiment isolates cache-disabled path and does not duplicate the known report.

initialization_failure_followup.finding: Global LoRA selector precedes explicit backend; target filtering can omit expert wrapper that supplies context. Profile fails before adapter load. Main still contains same ordering.
initialization_failure_followup.workaround: Official default target filter None verified on final GPU: initialization and all five A/B/A phases passed; all40 expert wrappers had context and zero active LoRA slots in each adapter phase. Original o_proj deployment filter startup witness preserved.

typed_lora_api_followup.finding: LoRARequest array_like msgspec Struct becomes list in nested generic RPC args. EngineCoreProc converts only top-level typed Struct parameters. Official LLMEngine.add_lora routes typed utility and reconstructs request. Local probe API misuse, not new upstream issue.
typed_lora_api_followup.cpu_gate: Actual MsgpackEncoder/Decoder and EngineCoreProc._convert_msgspec_args bound to generic versus add_lora methods, plus actual loader mapper and expert buffer methods.
